summary: Verified all 3 reported bug-fix groups (Home nav/layout, Food search quality, Workout screen) end-to-end via backend pytest + Playwright mobile flows starting from '/' through onboarding. All reported symptoms are fixed and working. 26/26 backend tests passed (6 new food-search tests + 20 regression). Full frontend flow (onboarding -> home -> add-btn -> date strip -> meal add -> search -> pick -> workout autocomplete/sets/save/history) verified with no red screens or blocking bugs.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 660 lines - approaching the 700-line split threshold; consider extracting food-search helpers (_off_query/_process_hits/_parse_size_grams) into a separate module (e.g. food_search.py) if more logic is added later.

No functional issues found in reviewed code for the 3 fix groups; tabBarButton override, DateStrip scrollToEnd, MealSection always-render-4, foods/search dedup+relevance+country-fallback, search.tsx serving_grams default, and workout.tsx autocomplete/category/sets/history all match spec exactly.
seed_data_creation: Created transient anon test users via /api/auth/anon with device_id prefixed TEST_ (backend tests) and via full onboarding wizard flow (frontend tests, names TesterBot/TesterBot2/TesterBot3). No persistent seed data left needing cleanup (anon users are disposable).
context_for_next_testing_agent: IMPORTANT testing-methodology note (not an app bug): navigating Playwright directly to /home or /workout in a NEW browser automation script call bypasses index.tsx's authAnon() bootstrap and yields fresh/empty AsyncStorage (IndexedDB on web) in that isolated context, causing 401/422 'Missing X-User-Id header' and default/zero values on screen. This is purely a test-tool artifact (each mcp_browser_automation call = fresh browser context) -- always start at '/' and complete onboarding within the SAME script call before testing /home, /search, or /workout, exactly as instructed in the review request's agent_to_agent_context_note. All real verification in this run was done correctly within single continuous sessions and everything passed.
